biocontainers.name: bioconductor-scgps
biocontainers.summary: A complete analysis of single cell subpopulations, from identifying subpopulations to analysing their relationship (scGPS = single cell Global Predictions of Subpopulation)

biotools.summary: The package implements two main algorithms to answer two key questions: a SCORE (Stable Clustering at Optimal REsolution) to find subpopulations, followed by scGPS to investigate the relationships between subpopulations.
